tailOfTheActiveBackendLog: Tail of the active backend log file plus rotated downloads.
taskIdentifierFirstOtherwiseJiraLinear: Task identifier first; otherwise Jira, Linear, GitHub issue, or GitHub PR metadata. Examples: KAN-123, #42.
taskTitleSanitizedToLowercaseAscii: Task title sanitized to lowercase ASCII, hyphen-separated, max 20 chars. Example: fix-login-flow.
taskWorkbenchLayoutProfilesAndDefaults: Task workbench layout profiles and defaults
theBackendIsRunningAgainReload: The backend is running again. Reload the page to reconnect with the latest feature toggle state.
theBuiltInDefaultLayoutWill: The built-in Default layout will become the default.
theCliCommandThatWillBe: The CLI command that will be executed based on the current settings.
theGoBuildCacheIsBelow: The Go build cache is below its configured size limit.
themeMetricsAndChangesPanelPreferences: Theme, metrics, and changes panel preferences
theNewTaskUsesItsWorkflow: The new task uses its workflow profile when one is set; otherwise it uses the default profile of the workspace receiving the task. Choose this to keep agent-created tasks on your standard workspace model and avoid accidentally reusing an expensive profile.
theNewTaskUsesTheSame: The new task uses the same profile as the task that created it. Choose this when follow-up work needs the same model and agent setup. This may reuse a more expensive profile.
theRemoteDockerHostUrlTcp: The remote Docker host URL (tcp://, ssh://).
theRestartCouldNotBeCompleted: The restart could not be completed.
theseSessionsWillNoLongerBe: These sessions will no longer be able to use this profile and the listed watchers will be disabled. This action cannot be undone.
thisBrowserDoesNotSupportDesktop: This browser does not support desktop notifications.
thisCannotBeUndoneKandevWill: This cannot be undone. Kandev will permanently remove {{target}}.
thisDeploymentMustKeepAtLeast: This deployment must keep at least one active admin.
thisIsACleanupTriggerNot: This is a cleanup trigger, not a hard quota. The cache may grow past this size while tasks are active. Maintenance rotates the owned cache into quarantine and recreates an empty cache after the limit is exceeded.
thisIsShownOnlyOnceCopy: This is shown only once — copy it now and store it securely.
thisLayoutIsUsedAsThe: This layout is used as the starting layout for new tasks.
thisPluginDoesNotDeclareAny: This plugin does not declare any settings (no <1>config_schema</1> in its manifest).
thisProfileIsCurrentlyInUse: This profile is currently in use. Deleting it will affect the following:
thisProfileWillBeRemovedWhen: This profile will be removed when you save.
thisWillPermanentlyDeleteThisProfile: This will permanently delete this profile. This action cannot be undone.
thisWillPermanentlyRemoveAndRevoke: This will permanently remove <2>{{pluginName}}</2> and revoke its API key. This action cannot be undone.
thisWillPermanentlyRemoveTheAgent: This will permanently remove the agent and all its profiles. This action cannot be undone.
thisWillPermanentlyRemoveThisAction: This will permanently remove <2>{{targetLabel}}</2>. This action cannot be undone.
thisWillPermanentlyRemoveThisAction2: This will permanently remove <2>{{value0}}</2>. This action cannot be undone.
thisWillRemoveTheRepositoryAnd: This will remove the repository and its scripts. This action cannot be undone.
thisWipesTheEntireKandevInstall: This wipes the entire kandev install: database, worktrees, repo clones, sessions, tasks, and quick-chat sessions.
tokenConfiguredButUnableToConnect: Token configured but unable to connect.
tokensPrependedToTheAgentLaunch: Tokens prepended to the agent launch command, so it runs under a sandbox launcher (e.g. <2>greywall --</2>). The value is shell-tokenised. Leave empty to run the agent directly. Applies to ACP sessions only — it has no effect when the profile uses TUI passthrough.
toolsAcrossCategoriesExpandToPreview: {{total}} tools across {{groupCount}} categories — expand to preview what external agents can do.
toolsListWorkspacesListBoardsList: Tools: list_workspaces, list_boards, list_workflow_steps, list_tasks, create_task, update_task
trustThisHostIVeVerified: <0>Trust this host.</0> I’ve verified the fingerprint above matches my server. Future connections that report a different fingerprint will be refused.
typeInsertsTheTaskDescriptionOr: Type {{ for placeholders ( <3>{{task_prompt}}</3> inserts the task description) or @ to reference a saved prompt by name — its content is attached as hidden context, and editing the saved prompt updates every step that references it. Note: {{task_prompt}} only expands in the step prompt itself, not inside a referenced saved prompt.
typeTheseDuringASessionChat: Type these during a session chat to invoke them - e.g. <1>/init</1>.
typeTheWorkspaceNameToConfirm: Type the workspace name <1>{{workspaceName}}</1> to confirm deletion. This action cannot be undone.
typeToEnableTheConfirmButton: Type <1>{{token}}</1> to enable the confirm button.
typeTokenToConfirmDeletion: Type {{token}} to confirm deletion. This action cannot be undone.
typeTokenToEnableConfirmAndRelaunch: Type <1>{{token}}</1> to enable the confirm button. After the wipe completes you'll be asked to quit and relaunch Kandev - the backend does not auto-restart.
typeToSeeAvailableVariablesWith: Type {{ to see available variables with autocomplete
unusedByEveryContainerAndOlder: Unused by every container and older than the configured age
useAndTrimAKandevOwned: Use and trim a Kandev-owned cache for new host-local Go executions.
usedByRemoteExecutorsForCommit: Used by remote executors for commit author configuration.
usedToStartThePreviewDev: Used to start the preview dev server for this repository. Use <2>$PORT</2> for automatic port allocation.
useNameInTheChatInput: Use <1>@name</1> in the chat input to insert a prompt’s content. Prompts are matched by name and expanded in place.
usesDockerSAgeAndStorage: Uses Docker's age and storage filters to remove old build cache. It does not run docker system prune, does not remove volumes globally, and remains disabled until the dedicated-daemon acknowledgment is confirmed.
usesTheLocalDockerDaemonOn: Uses the local Docker daemon on this machine.
useThisIfYouWantTo: Use this if you want to manage Kandev from coding agents that run <2>outside</2> Kandev (e.g. Claude Code, Cursor, or Codex on your host), or from <4>passthrough agents</4> running inside Kandev. <6></6> Agents launched inside Kandev in their normal mode already have the Kandev MCP wired in automatically, no setup needed.
useThisLayoutAsTheStarting: Use this layout as the starting layout for new tasks.
useThisSettingWhenAnAgent: Use this setting when an agent calls a Kandev MCP tool that creates a task. If the call does not choose a profile, Kandev must assign an agent profile to the new task. That profile controls its agent, model, and setup.
viewAllReleasesAndManageNotification: View all releases and manage notification preferences
waitForGoCacheAdoptionTo: Wait for Go cache adoption to finish.
waitForStorageSettingsToFinish: Wait for storage settings to finish loading.
waitForTheCurrentStorageAction: Wait for the current storage action to finish.
walksEveryDirectoryInsideTheData: Walks every directory inside the data folder and adds up the file sizes. Results are cached for a couple of hours; click to compute fresh numbers right now. Can take a few seconds on large workspaces.
warningThisFingerprintDiffersFromThe: Warning: this fingerprint differs from the one currently pinned ( <1>{{currentlyPinned}}</1>). Trusting it overwrites the pinned key. If you didn’t expect a host re-key, stop here.
whenEnabledASparkleIconAppears: When enabled, a sparkle icon appears in the topbar when a new version is released
whenEnabledKandevChecksThisPolicy: When enabled, Kandev checks this policy at the configured interval and starts only after Kandev has been idle for the required period. Turning it off does not disable Analyze or Run now.
whenEnabledKandevGivesNewLocal: When enabled, Kandev gives new local task processes a dedicated Go build cache and may rotate it during maintenance when it exceeds the maximum. Turning this off stops using the managed cache for new executions but does not delete it.
willBeReplacedWithYourTask: <0>{{PROMPT_TOKEN}}</0> will be replaced with your task description or follow-up message.
wipesAllKandevDataTasksSessions: Wipes ALL Kandev data: tasks, sessions, settings, repositories, and worktrees. There is no undo. A backup is taken first, but restoring it requires using the Backups page after the reset. Only use this if you want to start over from scratch.
writeAheadLogSqliteWritesNew: Write-Ahead Log. SQLite writes new changes to this companion file first and merges them into the main database over time. A non-zero WAL size is normal - it temporarily grows under load and shrinks back during checkpoints. Running vacuum will reset it.
writeLiteralPrefixesDirectlyForExample: Write literal prefixes directly, for example <2>{{branchTemplateExample}}</2>.
writingTheSnapshotOverTheLive: Writing the snapshot over the live database...
